caption:
As I reflect on my time at Colorado, it’s hard to put into words what this chapter has truly meant to me. I never imagined this journey would come to a close in this way, but I am deeply grateful for every moment that led me here.

I also reflect on Justice Elliott, whose no longer with me but his belief in me continues to guide and motivate me.

From day one, my experience was filled with gratitude, love, and unwavering positivity. Colorado became more than just a program I was proud and honored to represent. It became a place I will always consider home.

I want to sincerely thank Rick George, Coach Prime, Coach Ray, Coach Gunnar, Coach G, Coach Dre, Swasey, Coach J. Phil, Chef Solomon, Brady, AP, Lo, Luke and Smitty, Ms. LT, and the entire staff. The relationships built and the memories created during my time here will stay with me forever.

To my brothers who will be on that field next season, keep grinding, keep believing, and keep rolling. And to the fans of Colorado, thank you for welcoming me with open arms and supporting me every step of the way.

This chapter may be closing, but the impact of this experience and the people who helped shape it will stay with me for life.

- Jordan Seaton

caption:
🦬 Thank you football.

It’s crazy to think after 5 years, such a constant in my life has finally come to an end. Ever since I was little and I got to attend my first CU game with my grandfather, I dreamed of running out behind Ralphie.

Football demanded massive sacrifices, but also gave me the most incredible gifts. The gift of an amazing brotherhood of men who pushed me to be the best version of myself every day. The gift of the most amazing and supportive friends and fans who showed up on game day to support the black and gold. And the gift of a family who has taught me so much and made me the man I am today. I can honestly say every 6am practice, late night, early morning, lift, run, and moment I thought I couldn’t give more but still did, was all worth it. I’m forever grateful for my time at CU.

To everyone who believed in me when I didn’t believe in myself. To every coach who demanded more. To every teammate who made me laugh on the toughest days. To the fans who made Saturdays feel like magic. To the amazing tailgate crew always showing up at West 7. And to my family who loved me through the wins, the losses, the injuries, and every version of me in between thank you. You carried me more than you’ll ever know.

On to the next chapter. But a piece of my heart will always live in Folsom, under the lights, wearing black and gold.

Sko Buffs, #79 🖤💛 🦬

Client Testimonial - @lexsoulchild  Offensive Lineman, University of @cubuffsfootball 

As a collegiate athlete, I’ve spent nearly half my life in the weight room, training hard under the guidance of some of the best coaches in the game. I believed I had already reached my peak performance—until I joined Coach Derek’s off-season football strength and conditioning program at CrossFit MABA LAB. 

From day one, Coach Derek emphasized building a solid foundation through strength training, while placing a strong focus on improving my range of motion and mobility, particularly in my hips and shoulders. I was skeptical at first, but after just a few weeks, I began to feel a dramatic difference in my recovery, movement quality, and overall performance.

Thanks to Coach Derek’s expertise and programming, I now feel stronger and more powerful than ever before. I’ve developed the flexibility to hit full-depth squats and move into positions I previously couldn’t achieve.

I highly recommend Coach Derek’s off-season strength and conditioning program to any athlete serious about elevating their performance and preparing at the highest level for their season.

caption:
WHAT IT TAKES TO BE A CHAMPION

“Champions are not the people who never fail, they are the one’s who never quit.”

« Champions do not become champions when they win the event, but in the hours, weeks, months and years they spend preparing for it. 

The victorious performance itself is merely the demonstration of their championship character. » 

He is Dr. Kevin Elko (world-renowned Sports Psychologist). In 2022, he was asked, « What’s the one trait that all champions have? »

His answer was ONE word.

He said, « They’re UNBREAKABLE. »

He said, “You can’t break them. They’re unbreakable. They have a vision of themselves. They have a concept they believe about themselves and they’ll do anything to protect it. »

How do they get this way? They do 2 things:

1. They believe in themselves - Self-belief and self-confidence comes from within. Top performers have a vision of themselves, what they want, and they work to become that vision. He said, « They’ll protect that vision. You won’t crack them. » Their drive and belief allow them to choose resilience even when challenges and obstacles get in their way. 

2. They take ownership of themselves - They take ownership of their attitude, effort, and mindset through the standard that they set. It’s important to create a standard and live to that standard because you build good habits from that standard. He said, “When your habits are powerful and they are effective, you start to win now. If you don’t develop habits intentionally, you will develop the bad ones.”. Champions take ownership of their attitude, effort, and mindset.

Extremely thankful for all the memories made with the Lux youth nationalteams over these past years. It is always an honor to represent our country. 
Making it this far with the girls is something that will be a memory forever to be cherished! 
So grateful for all the opportunities received and being able to experience them with the most amazing group of people! The amount of support inside and outside of the team has been truly amazing and will forever be grateful for that! 
i have so much gratitude for all of our coaches for not only coaching us to grow as basketball players but also as people! Despite the highs and lows, they continued to believe in us and made sure that we stayed together. I wouldn’t be standing where I am right now without the amount of support and belief that they gave me and the whole team!
With so many ups and downs on the way, couldn’t have imagined it to end better than to go down in history with this team! 
Truly believe that our endless hard work paid off at the end! most importantly I’m so happy that we got to experience everything together and see that nothing is impossible!
So much love for my second family❤️‍🩹

caption: The amount of trials and tribulations I've been through is crazy. Only played 3 games at DVC but by the Grace of God, was still able to get 7 offers and committed to Ole Miss to continue my journey of football. After my commitment, my son was born and thats when I became a Born-Again Believer in my Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. I felt Jesus spiritually entering into my heart, letting me know that He's never left nor forsaken me (Deuteronomy 31:6). I knew then and there that I had to get a Bible to learn more about Him. Since I've gotten into the word and learning about Jesus, I also decided to finally go to church WILLINGLY and ultimately got baptized. But it wasn't the water that saved me from condemnation, but rather my faith in Jesus of Nazareth. The baptizing was simply my message to the world of professing my belief in Him!! Thanks to Him, I'm living a great life. Thanks to Him, I'm married with an amazing and beautiful wife who gave birth to our beautiful son. Thanks to Him, for everything because without Him I was nothing. Without Him, I was lost but now I'm FOUND! Jesus is God and He came to this Earth willingly to die for not just me but for everyone else. We are made righteous through our faith, not of our works (Ephesians 2:8-9). Thank you Jesus for the free gift of entrance into Heaven. I'm saved and any of you can be saved as well. And thank you to the most amazing wife ever. She's been through all these trials every step of the way beside me. Couldn't be more grateful ♥️
